spec_match.rationale: AudioWorkletProcessor sine generator whose per-callback frame count empirically measures the real render quantum — CDP-verified: hint 256 requested, log honestly reported renderQuantumSize=128 and the counted ~344 callbacks/sec confirms 128-frame quanta at 44.1kHz.

interactive.rationale: Hint buttons, start/stop with proper disabled-state management, live waveform canvas, stats grid, and a timestamped context log all function (CDP-driven start verified 'Running').

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the worklet, the actual honoured quantum, base latency, and callbacks-per-second in real time; all present and live.

edge_cases.rationale: Explicit banner that older browsers ignore the option and lock to 128 frames, try/catch around context creation, and stop/restart cycling.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 plus spec material and siblings.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the guarded feature suite (7/7 here); the callback-rate measurement corroborates the default-128 assertion empirically.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Start/stop, stats, log, and callbacks/sec verified via CDP with clean console in Chromium 141; a hint actually changing the quantum requires Chrome with the OT/153 and was not observable here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: ctrl-btn variants override background and color together; canvas and stats use shared variables.

accessibility.rationale: Canvas has an aria-label and buttons are native with clear disabled states, but stats and the log update without live regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured clean at 360x740 (scrollWidth 360); desktop verified via screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Refresh 'stable M151' comment
openQuestions.detail: The code sample says 'Chrome 145 origin trial (stable M151)' but chromestatus now shows the OT running 145–151 with shipping proposed at 153; update so the copy stays evidence-based.

openQuestions.title: Announce stats to assistive tech
openQuestions.detail: The four stat cards and context log are silent updates; a polite live region on the log would narrate context creation and quantum readouts.

summary: Best-in-feature demo: the worklet's measured ~344 callbacks/sec independently proves the 128-frame quantum this pre-support browser renders, the hint-ignored fallback is stated up front, and every control worked under CDP with a clean console and clean 360px layout. Only minor copy staleness and missing live regions noted. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
